When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.af: Wanneer inkomste ’n vlak oorsteek, geld die hoër koers vir alle inkomste in die tydperk.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.zu: Uma imali engenayo idlula izinga, izinga eliphezulu lisebenza kuyo yonke imali engenayo ngesikhathi.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.xh: Xa ingeniso idlula inqanaba, ixabiso eliphezulu lisebenza kuyo yonke ingeniso ngexesha elo.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.st: Ha chelete e kenang e feta boemo, sekgahla se phahameng se sebetsa ho chelete eohle ya nako eo.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.nso: Ge letseno le feta boemo, kelo ye e phagamego e šoma go letseno ka moka nakong yeo.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.tn: Fa lotseno lo feta boemo, kelo e e kwa godimo e dira mo lotsenong lotlhe mo nakong eo.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.ts: Loko mali leyi nghenaka yi hundza xiyimo, ntsengo wa le henhla wu tirha eka mali hinkwayo hi nkarhi wolowo.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.ve: Musi mbuelo i tshi fhira tshigwada, mutevhe wa nṱha u shuma kha mbuelo yoṱhe nga tshifhinga tshenetsho.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.ss: Uma imali lengenako idlula lizinga, lizinga leliphezulu lisebenta kuyo yonkhe imali ngesikhatsi leso.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.fr: Lorsqu'un palier de recettes est dépassé, le taux supérieur s'applique à toutes les recettes de la période.
When revenue crosses a tier, the higher.ar: عندما يتجاوز الإيراد شريحة، يُطبَّق المعدل الأعلى على كل الإيراد في الفترة.

Each tier rate applies only to revenue w.af: Elke vlakkoers geld slegs vir inkomste binne daardie groep.

Each tier rate applies only to revenue w.nso: Kelo ya boemo bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe e šoma fela go letseno ka gare ga sehlopha seo.
Each tier rate applies only to revenue w.tn: Kelo ya boemo bongwe le bongwe e dira fela mo lotsenong lo lo mo gare ga setlhopha seo.
Each tier rate applies only to revenue w.ts: Ntsengo wa xiyimo xin'wana na xin'wana wu tirha ntsena eka mali leyi nghenaka endzeni ka ntlawa lowu.
Each tier rate applies only to revenue w.ve: Mutevhe wa tshigwada tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe u shuma fhedzi kha mbuelo ngeno ha tshigwada tshenetsho.
Each tier rate applies only to revenue w.ss: Lizinga ngalinye lisebenta kuphela emalini lengenako phakatsi kwalelo libandla.
Each tier rate applies only to revenue w.fr: Chaque taux de palier ne vaut que pour les recettes de cette tranche.
Each tier rate applies only to revenue w.ar: يُطبَّق معدل كل شريحة على الإيراد داخل تلك الشريحة فقط.

Owners and staff with admin access alway.af: Eienaars en personeel met bestuurdertoegang het altyd volle regte. Hul skakelaars kan hier net gelees word.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.zu: Abanikazi nabasebenzi abanokufinyelela kokuphatha bahlala benawo wonke amalungelo. Izinkinobho zabo zifundeka kuphela lapha.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.xh: Abanini nabasebenzi abanokufikelela kolawulo bahlala benawo onke amalungelo. Amaqhosha abo afundeka kuphela apha.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.st: Beng le basebetsi ba nang le phihlelo ya tsamaiso ba na le ditokelo tsohle kamehla. Dikonopo tsa bona di balwa feela mona.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.nso: Beng le bašomi bao ba nago le phihlelelo ya taolo ba na le ditokelo ka moka ka mehla. Dikonope tša bona di balwa fela mo.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.tn: Beng le badiri ba ba nang le phitlhelelo ya taolo ba na le ditshwanelo tsotlhe ka metlha. Dikonope tsa bone di balwa fela fa.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.ts: Vativi na vatirhi lava nga na mfikelelo wa vulawuri va tshama va ri na mpfumelelo hinkwawo. Swikhiya swa vona swi hlayiwa ntsena laha.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.ve: Vhane na vhashumi vha re na u swikelela ha ndaulo vha na pfanelo dzoṱhe tshifhinga tshoṱhe. Zwikhiya zwavho zwi vhalwa fhedzi fhano.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.ss: Banikati nebantfu labanemvume yekuphatsa bahlala banawo onkhe emalungelo. Tinkinobho tabo tifundvwa kuphela lapha.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.fr: Les propriétaires et le personnel avec un accès administrateur ont toujours tous les droits. Leurs interrupteurs sont en lecture seule ici.
Owners and staff with admin access alway.ar: المالكون والموظفون ذوو صلاحية الإدارة لديهم دائمًا كل الصلاحيات. مفاتيحهم هنا للقراءة فقط.
